title: Membership Fee Charging and Billing Periods
content:
Billing standard for the paid tiers of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships.

**Charge.** Paid tiers are charged the tier's membership fee once per billing period; Northgate Rewards is never charged. The tier charged is the tier recorded on the membership on the billing period start date, and a plan change takes effect only from the next renewal date. Fees are not prorated when a period starts, and the Northgate Card cardholder discount never applies to membership fees. The amount charged is the tier's fee.

**Billing periods.** Billing periods start on the term start date and then every term length in calendar months on the same calendar day, falling back to the last day of a shorter month; the renewal date is always the start of the next billing period. Renewal fees fall on the day set by the tier's renewal charge day. The fee is charged on the billing period start date to the payment method recorded on the membership, and a fee charged to a Northgate Card posts to that card account as a purchase.

**Chargeable status.** A renewal fee is charged only on a membership in enrolled, trial, active or payment hold status. A membership in cancel pending or canceled status is never charged again.

**Student limit.** A Northgate+ Student membership whose student months have reached the tier's maximum discounted months is charged at the Northgate+ Monthly fee from the next renewal, through a plan change. Student months are the number of settled membership fee charges, on any membership record of the customer, whose tier at the charge is Northgate+ Student, over the customer's whole membership history up to the date being evaluated.

**Declines and reminders.** A declined scheduled attempt is recorded as attempt number 0 and is handled under the payment hold rule. A reminder is sent the tier's trial conversion reminder days before a trial converts and the tier's annual renewal reminder days before an annual renewal; reminders do not move the charge date.

**Billing period dates (hypothetical monthly term starting 31 January 2031)**

| Period | Start date | Renewal date (start of the next period) |
|---|---|---|
| first | 31 January 2031 | 28 February 2031 |
| second | 28 February 2031 | 31 March 2031 |
| third | 31 March 2031 | 30 April 2031 |

**Status table for a scheduled renewal fee**

| Membership status on the charge date | Renewal fee charged |
|---|---|
| enrolled, trial, active or payment hold | yes |
| cancel pending or canceled | no, never again |
